role: Actual frontier subagent reasoning over the digital recipe context and initial physical observation
rationale: The recipe explicitly requests a cue at the start of bowl movement. An evidence-backed geometric motion_started event is the local trigger; semantic pickup recognition is not needed to issue this cue.
The approved local response registry supplies recipe-movement-cue. The watch contains only its response ID and cannot select arbitrary Home Assistant commands.
No persistent physical identity is yet available. Matching the bowl label is appropriate for this bounded single-seed replay, but would be ambiguous if other bowl tracks were present.
The 0.5 threshold is an operational cutoff for an uncalibrated geometric score, not a 50% probability claim. A one-second response deadline and freshness limit reflect the requested immediate cue.
A one-hour TTL allows setup and replay; the immediate response still depends on newly available evidence within its source-relative deadline.
Motion alone cannot establish pickup. No automated physical outcome predicate is installed; I will assess the delivered sequence independently after the runtime.
required_pickup_evidence: Chronological real frames showing the initially observed nested bowls on the worktop, followed by hand contact or a grasp and visible displacement of the same bowl group away from its original support.
Multiple frames supporting lift or carry, with the bowl movement distinguishable from camera motion, occlusion, tracker drift, or motion of a nearby object.
Source media and timing references sufficient to associate the interaction with this recipe step. The initial box is an assistant-selected bootstrap, not ground-truth tracking annotation.
Separate records for cue execution/readback, transport acknowledgement, and the physical completion judgment. An HA state change or an event delivery alone is insufficient.
